data.long_meaning: Rabinder is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Ravi' meaning sun and 'Bindu' meaning drop. The name Rabinder carries the meaning “Servant of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Punjabi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Rabinder usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
